source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Ensure that the required fields are filled out completely. For example, a day and time is recorded.
3. Fill out the description section with the sequence of events, including what the worker was doing at the time of the accident.
4. Document the accident in First Incident Reports by creating a new form each week.
5. Submit individual copies to the site supervisor when the report is completed.

Once a First Incident Report is submitted it becomes a file...

1. Fill out the header fields completely.
2. File the report and copy in the on-site First Incident Report file.
3. Send a copy to the plant coordinator.

To complete the accident investigation:

1. Contact the incident reporting company.
2. Answer all of their questions accurately.
3. Confirm that the record of the incident has been filed.<eos>
